top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The 5 staff files reviewed did not have form 2912 included.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The first aid kit was missing tweezers.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director could not produce 30 hours of required annual training.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not produce proof of liability insurance.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.
